verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu ittaqoo rabbakum inna zalzalatas-saa'ati shay'un azeem
Yawma tarawnahaa tadhhalu kullu murdi'atin ammaa arda'at wa tada'u kullu dhaati hamlin hamlahaa wa taran-naasa sukaaraa wa maa hum bisukaaraa wa laakinna adhaaba Allaahi shadeed
Wa minan-naasi man yujaadilu fee Allaahi bighayri ilmin wa yattabi'u kulla shaytaanin mareed
Kutiba alayhi annahu man tawallaahu fa-annahu yudilluhu wa yahdeehi ilaa adhaabis-sa'eer

Yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee raybin minal-ba'thi fa-innaa khalaqnaakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min alaqatin thumma min mudghatin mukhallaqatin wa ghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wa nuqirru fil-arhaami maa nashaa'u ilaa ajalin musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum wa minkum man yutawaffaa wa minkum man yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-umuri likaylaa ya'lama min ba'di ilmin shay'an wa taral-arda haamidatan fa-idhaa anzalnaa alayhal-maa'a ihtazzat wa rabat wa anbatat min kulli zawjin baheej
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha huwal-haqqu wa annahu yuhyil-mawtaa wa annahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa annas-saa'ata aatiyatun laa rayba feehaa wa annallaaha yab'athu man fil-quboor
Wa minan-naasi man yujaadilu fee Allaahi bighayri ilmin wa laa hudan wa laa kitaabin muneer
Thaaniya itfihi liyudilla an sabeelillaahi lahu fid-dunyaa khizyun wa nudheequhu yawmal-qiyaamati adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat yadaaka wa annallaaha laysa bizallaamin lil-abeed
Wa minan-naasi man ya'budu Allaaha alaa harfin fa-in asaabahu khayrun itma'anna bihi wa in asaabathu fitnatun inqalaba alaa wajhihi khasirad-dunyaa wal-aakhirata dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
Yad'oo min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhu wa maa laa yanfa'uhu dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba'eed
Yad'oo laman darruhu aqrabu min naf'ihi labi'sal-mawlaa wa labi'sal-asheer
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru innallaaha yaf'alu maa yureed
Man kaana yazunnu an lan yansurahu Allaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samaa'i thumma liyaqta falyanzur hal yudhhibanna kayduhu maa yagheez
Wa kadhalika anzalnaahu aayaatin bayyinaatin wa annallaaha yahdee man yureed
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'eena wan-nasaaraa wal-majoosa wal-ladheena ashrakoo innallaaha yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in shaheed

Alam taraa annallaaha yasjudu lahu man fis-samaawaati wa man fil-ardi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujoomu wal-jibaalu wash-shajaru wad-dawaabbu wa katheerun minan-naasi wa katheerun haqqa alayhil-adhaabu wa man yuhini Allaahu famaa lahu min mukrimin innallaaha yaf'alu maa yashaa
Haadhaani khasmaani ikhtasamoo fee rabbihim fa-al-ladheena kafaroo qutti'at lahum thiyaabun min naarin yusabbu min fawqi ru'oosihimul-hameem
Yusharu bihi maa fee butoonihim wal-julood
Wa lahum maqaami'u min hadeed
Kullamaa araadoo an yakhrujoo minhaa min ghammin u'eedoo feehaa wa dhooqoo adhaabal-hareeq
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabin wa lu'ulu'uan wa libaasuhum feehaa hareer
Wa hudoo ilat-tayyibi minal-qawli wa hudoo ilaa siraatil-hameed

Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi wal-masjidil-haraamil-ladhee ja'alnaahu lin-naasi sawaa'an al-aakifu feehi wal-baadi wa man yurid feehi bi-ilhaadin bizulmin nudhiqhu min adhaabin aleem
Wa idh bawwa'naa li-ibraaheema makaanal-bayti an laa tushrik bee shay'an wa tahhir baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-qaa'imeena war-rukka'is-sujood
Wa adhdhin fin-naasi bil-hajji ya'tooka rijaalan wa alaa kulli daamirin ya'teena min kulli fajjin ameeq
Liyashhadoo manaafi'a lahum wa yadhkuroo isma Allaahi fee ayyaamin ma'loomaatin alaa maa razaqahum min baheematil-an'aam fakuloo minhaa wa at'imul-baa'isal-faqeer
Thumma liyaqdoo tafathahum wa lyoofoo nudhoorahum wa lyattawwafoo bil-baytil-ateeq
Dhaalika wa man yu'azzim hurumaati Allaahi fahuwa khayrun lahu inda rabbihi wa uhillat lakumul-an'aam illaa maa yutlaa alaykum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-awthaani wajtaniboo qawlaz-zoor
Hunafaa'a Lillaahi ghayra mushrikeena bihi wa man yushrik Billaahi faka'annamaa kharra minas-samaa'i fatakhtafuhut-tayru aw tahwee bihir-reehu fee makaanin saheeq
Dhaalika wa man yu'azzim sha'aa'ira Allaahi fa-innahaa min taqwal-quloob
Lakum feehaa manaafi'u ilaa ajalin musamman thumma mahilluhaa ilal-baytil-ateeq
Wa likulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan liyadhkuroo isma Allaahi alaa maa razaqahum min baheematil-an'aami fa-ilahukum ilaahun waahidun falahu aslimoo wa bashshiril-mukhbiteen
Al-ladheena idhaa dhukira Allaahu wajilat quloobuhum was-saabireena alaa maa asaabahum wal-muqeemis-salaati wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon

Wal-budna ja'alnaahaa lakum min sha'aa'iri Allaahi lakum feehaa khayrun fadhkuroo isma Allaahi alayhaa sawaaffa fa-idhaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakuloo minhaa wa at'imul-qaani'a wal-mu'tarra kadhaalika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la-allakum tashkuroon
Lan yanaala Allaaha luhoomuhaa wa laa dimaa'uuhaa wa laakin yanaaluhut-taqwaa minkum kadhaalika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbiroo Allaaha alaa maa hadaakum wa bashshiril-muhsineen
Innallaaha yudaafi'u anil-ladheena aamanoo innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla khawwaanin kafoor
Udhina lilladheena yuqaataloona bi-annahum zulimoo wa innallaaha alaa nasrihim laqadeer

Al-ladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim bighayri haqqin illaa an yaqooloo rabbunaa Allaahu wa lawlaa daf'u Allaahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'din lahuddimat sawaami'u wa biya'un wa salawaatun wa masaajidu yudhkaru feehas-mu Allaahi katheeran wa layansuranna Allaahu man yansuruhu innallaaha laqawiyyun azeez
Al-ladheena in makkannaahum fil-ardi aqaamus-salaata wa aataw az-zakaata wa amaroo bil-ma'roofi wa nahaw anil-munkari wa Lillaahi aaqibatul-umoor
Wa in yukadhdhibooka faqad kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa aadun wa thamood
Wa qawmu ibraaheema wa qawmu loot
Wa ashaabu madyana wa kudhdhiba moosaa fa-amlaytu lilkaafireena thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana nakeer
Faka'ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa wa hiya zaalimatun fahiya khaawiyatun alaa urooshihaa wa bi'rin mu'attalatin wa qasrin masheed
Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fatakoona lahum quloobun ya'qiloona bihaa aw aadhaanun yasma'oona bihaa fa-innahaa laa ta'mal-absaaru wa laakin ta'mal-quloobul-latee fis-sudoor
Wa yasta'jiloonaka bil-adhaabi wa lan yukhlifa Allaahu wa'dahu wa inna yawman inda rabbika ka'alfi sanatin mimmaa ta'uddoon
Wa ka'ayyin min qaryatin amlaytu lahaa wa hiya zaalimatun thumma akhadhtuhaa wa ilayyal-maseer
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu innamaa anaa lakum nadheerun mubeen
Fa-al-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem
Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem

Wa maa arsalnaa min qablika min rasoolin wa laa nabiyyin illaa idhaa tamannaa alqash-shaytaanu fee umniyyatihi fayansakhu Allaahu maa yulqish-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimu Allaahu aayaatihi Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Liyaj'ala maa yulqish-shaytaanu fitnatan lilladheena fee quloobihim maradun wal-qaasiyati quloobuhum wa innaz-zaalimeena lafee shiqaaqin ba'eed
Wa liya'lamal-ladheena ootul-ilma annahul-haqqu min rabbika fayu'minoo bihi fatukhbita lahu quloobuhum wa innallaaha lahaadil-ladheena aamanoo ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa laa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hattaa ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum adhaabu yawmin aqeem
Al-mulku yawma'idhin Lillaahi yahkumu baynahum fa-al-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fee jannaatin-na'eem
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa fa-ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun muheen
Wal-ladheena haajaroo fee sabeelillaahi thumma qutiloo aw maatoo layarzuqannahumu Allaahu rizqan hasanan wa innallaaha lahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahu wa innallaaha la-aleemun haleem
Dhaalika wa man aaqaba bimithli maa ooqiba bihi thumma bughiya alayhi layansurannahu Allaahu innallaaha la-afuwwun ghafoor
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa yoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa annallaaha samee'un baseer
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha huwal-haqqu wa anna maa yad'oona min doonihi huwal-baatilu wa annallaaha huwal-aliyyul-kabeer
Alam taraa annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fatusbihul-ardu mukhdarratan innallaaha lateefun khabeer
Lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa innallaaha lahuwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
Alam taraa annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fil-ardi wal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bi-amrihi wa yumsikus-samaa'a an taqa'a alal-ardi illaa bi-idhnihi innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofun Raheem
Wa huwal-ladhee ahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum innal-insaana lakafoor
Likulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan hum naasikoohu falaa yunaazi'unnaka fil-amri wad'u ilaa rabbika innaka la-alaa hudan mustaqeem
Wa in jaadalooka faquli Allaahu a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
Allaahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Alam ta'lam annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaa'i wal-ardi inna dhaalika fee kitaabin inna dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseer
Wa ya'budoona min doonillaahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sultaanan wa maa laysa lahum bihi ilmun wa maa liz-zaalimeena min naseer

Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin ta'rifu fee wujoohil-ladheena kafarul-munkara yakaadoona yastoona billadheena yatloona alayhim aayaatinaa qul afa'unabbi'ukum bisharrin min dhalikumun-naaru wa-adahaa Allaahul-ladheena kafaroo wa bi'sal-maseer

Yaa ayyuhan-naasu duriba mathalun fastami'oo lahu innal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi lan yakhluqoo dhubaaban wa lawij-tama'oo lahu wa in yaslubhumudh-dhubaabu shay'an laa yastanqidhoohu minhu da'ufat-taalibu wal-matloob
Maa qadaroo Allaaha haqqa qadrihi innallaaha laqawiyyun azeez
Allaahu yastafee minal-malaa'ikati rusulan wa minan-naasi innallaaha samee'un baseer
Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo irka'oo wasjudoo wa'budoo rabbakum waf'alul-khayra la-allakum tuflihoon

Wa jaahidoo fee Allaahi haqqa jihaadihi huwaj-tabaakum wa maa ja'ala alaykum fid-deeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraaheema huwa sammaakumul-muslimyna min qablu wa fee haadhaa liyakoonar-rasoolu shaheedan alaykum wa takoonoo shuhadaa'a alan-naasi fa-aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata wa'tasimoo Billaahi huwa mawlaakum fani'mal-mawlaa wa ni'man-naseer
